 Chris Stapleton Wins 2026 CMA Male Vocalist of the Year Over a Field With Two Rising Stars
 by 
 Arden Lambert 
 Arden Lambert 
 Arden Lambert covers breaking country music news for Country Thang Daily. If it just happened in country music, Arden is on it.
 November 18, 2026 9:54 PM CST 
 Get Country Thang Daily first on Google Get CTD first on Google Add us as a preferred source in Top Stories Add us as a preferred source Add 
 Chris Stapleton took home 2026 CMA Male Vocalist of the Year at the 60th Annual CMA Awards in Nashville on Nov. 18, 2026.
 A year ago, Zach Top and Stephen Wilson Jr. were new faces at the CMA Awards, and in 2026 both were up for this award against three of the biggest voices in country music. Stapleton beat Luke Combs, reigning winner Cody Johnson, Top and Wilson Jr., and the show aired live from Bridgestone Arena on ABC and Disney+.
 Cody Johnson Came in as the Reigning CMA Male Vocalist of the Year
 Cody Johnson won Male Vocalist of the Year in 2025, and he came back in 2026 with four nominations, including Entertainer of the Year and two for his single “The Fall.” He has 19 CMA Awards nominations in his career.
 Chris Stapleton went into the night with 46 career nominations, four of them this year, and he was set to perform with Mumford & Sons and with Wilson Jr. Luke Combs had three nominations this year and 31 in his career.
 Those three men are some of the most decorated voices of their generation, and the 2026 CMA Male Vocalist of the Year race put them up against two artists still early in the story.

 Wilson Jr. was nominated for both New Artist and Male Vocalist of the Year in 2026, along with Song and Music Video of the Year for “Gary,” a song he wrote by himself. He has five CMA nominations in his career, four of them this year.
 Two veterans of the big stage, one reigning champion and two men just getting started all heard the same name read out, Chris Stapleton, the 2026 CMA Male Vocalist of the Year.
